abilities.name: Champion Strike
abilities.text: Minimum 3 dice; Range 1; vs. Fortitude. On success, deal 2 Physical Slashing Damage. Surge 2: move the target 1 unit or move yourself 1 unit after resolution.

abilities.name: Challenge
abilities.text: Minimum 2 dice; Range 4; vs. Composure. On success, the target suffers -1 to all Defenses against the Champion until the end of the target's next Turn. This is not Exposed and therefore can stack with Exposed.

abilities.name: Turn Aside
abilities.text: Trigger: you are targeted by an opposed Action. Minimum 2 dice, unopposed. Gain +1 to the targeted Defense against the triggering Action. Surge 2: move 1 unit after it resolves.

system.gmNotes:
Role use. A Champion is an Elite ordinary enemy, not automatically a Boss. It can anchor a Severe or Critical encounter alongside other enemies without changing the encounter into a Leader or Solo structure.

Starting Enemy Example (Essence v0.6, Part XIV). Playtest reference; change its fictional presentation freely.
